question: I need to add delta data to table x. So, I need to create a cycle. I read table x, then I find the delta between the source and table x. After that, I insert the delta to table x. How to do this in dbt? Is it possible to break the cycle?
title: How to handle a cycle in dbt?
answer: I change it from ref to source. so instead of using ref, I use source. I create another schema for the source. just to break the cycle in dbt. so basically, 1 table has ref and source at the same time.
